name: cofoundry-ai
description: CoFoundry AI — early-team formation for startups (Implementation Contract v3.0)

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n server,web,speech -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @cofoundry/server" "npm run dev -w @cofoundry/web" "node scripts/speech-dev.mjs"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @cofoundry/web && npm run build -w @cofoundry/server
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && playwright test -c e2e/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:speech: cd services/speech && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .
